title: Custom eggless baby shower and gender reveal cakes for Westmead and Parramatta
summary:
A baby shower guest list is never one diet. Vegetarian aunties, Jain grandparents, an egg allergy nobody mentioned until the cake arrives — one cake has to work for all of them.

Ours does, every time. 100% eggless. Not some cakes, every cake, every one of 15 flavours, since 2019. Pink or blue reveal layer inside, gender reveal design on top. Six sizes from 6 inch serving 6–8 up to 16 inch serving 50–55.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Pickup from Wigram Street, Harris Park — under 10 minutes from Westmead or Parramatta CBD.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
keywords: baby shower cake safe for vegetarian and egg allergy guests
